description: This file contains a series of shell functions and test cases designed to validate the behavior of a wildcard matching utility ('wildmatch'). It includes tests for pattern matching, path matching, case sensitivity, character classes, recursive matching, and performance checks.

methods.name: match
methods.description: High-level function to setup and perform pattern matching tests with various matching functions (wildmatch, iwildmatch, pathmatch, ipathmatch) and compare their outputs, including file system-based matching via 'git ls-files'.

methods.name: match_with_function
methods.description: Performs a specific match test using a provided matching function, validating whether a text matches a pattern according to the expected result.

methods.name: match_with_ls_files
methods.description: Performs matching tests via 'git ls-files' to verify how files tracked by git match given patterns.
